name: MachineTranslation.com
description: Connect MachineTranslation.com to any MCP-compatible AI assistant and get the translation that 22 AI models agree on, directly in your chat, without switching tabs.

_published_faq.name: How do I add MachineTranslation.com to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add MachineTranslation.com to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://www.machinetranslation.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the MachineTranslation.com MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: MachineTranslation.com provides these MCP tools: list_languages and smart_translate.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to MachineTranslation.com?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to MachineTranslation.com in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
MachineTranslation.com requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
MachineTranslation.com is developed by Tomedes. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
